page_title: LIL 6-1 MET | Lille v Metz 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Benoit Millot has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+10' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+10' Soriba Diaoune (Lille) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball only crashes against the crossbar.
90+9' Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) sends a long ball in, but Berke Ozer comfortably gathers the ball.
90+8' The ball is cleared after Osame Sahraoui (Lille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+5' 6 - 1 What a hit! Ibou Sane (Metz) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot inside the left post. 6:1.
90+3' 6 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) was set free in the area by Soriba Diaoune and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom right corner. 6:0.

90+1' A loose ball is pounced on by Marius Broholm (Lille) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Jonathan Fischer is alert and makes a comfortable save.
90' Substitution. Ibou Sane (Metz) has come on for Cheikh Sabaly.
90' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ismael Guerti (Metz) replacing Jessy Deminguet.
90' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Soriba Diaoune (Lille) replaces Benjamin Andre.
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Jessy Deminguet (Metz). Benoit Millot doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

86' Marius Broholm (Lille) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.
86' The ratio of the ball possession is 66:34.
83' That's the end of the game for Felix Correia, who is replaced by Marius Broholm (Lille).

82' 5 - 0 It's a goal! Benjamin Andre (Lille) makes it 5:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Felix Correia and planted his close-range header into the top of the net. Jonathan Fischer was helpless.
79' Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
77' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Pape Sy (Metz) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Jonathan Fischer.
72' The injury to Pape Sy (Metz) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
72' Osame Sahraoui (Lille) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Benoit Millot who sees an offensive foul.
70' Metz have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

69' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save. The referee blows his whistle, Metz are awarded a corner kick.
67' Here is a change. Hamza Igamane is going off and Bruno Genesio gives the last tactical orders to Osame Sahraoui (Lille).
67' Bruno Genesio has decided to make a change. Nabil Bentaleb (Lille) replaces Mathias Fernandez-Pardo.
67' Here's the change. Aissa Mandi leaves the pitch and Nathan Ngoy (Lille) comes on as a substitute.

67' A dangerous towering header by Benjamin Stambouli (Metz) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
67' The referee signals a corner kick to Metz.

64' 4 - 0 Hakon Arnar Haraldsson sent in an inviting cross from the free kick which was met by Romain Perraud (Lille), and he shoots from close range. The ball went towards the bottom right corner, ricocheting in off the post. It's 4:0.
63' Cleo Melieres (Metz) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Millot and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
62' Berke Ozer makes a brilliant save! Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) met a rebound outside the box and attempted to beat the keeper low into the middle of the goal.
61' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
61' That will be all from Alpha Toure who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Gauthier Hein (Metz).
61' Stephane Le Mignan has decided to substitute Koffi Kouao and he is replaced by Cleo Melieres (Metz).
61' The substitution is prepared. Morgan Bokele Mputu (Metz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giorgi Abuashvili.

60' Thomas Meunier (Lille) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his strike flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
59' The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.

59' Thomas Meunier (Lille) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Lille win a corner kick.

58' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.

56' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
53' 3 - 0 Felix Correia (Lille) receives a precise pass inside the box from Mathias Fernandez-Pardo and he beats the goalkeeper with a neat finish into the left side of the net. 3:0.

52' Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed to the bottom left corner, but it lacks power and Berke Ozer pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
51' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Metz.
51' The resulting corner, taken by Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz), comes to nothing. Corner kick. Metz will have an opportunity.
50' Koffi Kouao (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but Berke Ozer comes off his line to gather the ball. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
49' A great run from Georgiy Tsitaishvili (Metz) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
48' Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Benoit Millot signals. Metz have a free kick.
46' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Bruno Genesio has made a change at the break. Ngalayel Mukau (Lille) has come on in place of Ayyoub Bouaddi.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+3' Habib Diallo (Metz) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+1' Hamza Igamane (Lille) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
42' Romain Perraud (Lille) swings in a cross from the corner, but Pape Sy reads it well and gathers the ball.

42' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. Lille force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

40' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.

39' The opposition back off Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille), who needs no second invitation to shoot from inside the box. It's a decent effort towards the bottom left corner, but Pape Sy denies him with the save.
38' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lille comes to nothing.
36' Benoit Millot shows the yellow card to Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille) for a heavy challenge.

34' 2 - 0 GOAL! And it’s the keeper’s mistake after his poor pass is easily intercepted by Felix Correia (Lille), who gleefully finds the net from mid range with a first time effort. That makes it 2:0.
33' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lille.

32' Hamza Igamane (Lille) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
31' Metz have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
30' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Metz force their opponents to concede a corner.
30' Metz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. The linesman points to the corner flag, Metz are going to take it.
29' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

27' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
26' Stephane Le Mignan (Metz) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.

24' 1 - 0 Mathias Fernandez-Pardo produces a sweet pass and picks out Hamza Igamane (Lille) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:0!
23' A crossfield pass from Giorgi Abuashvili (Metz) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
22' Benoit Millot shows a yellow card to Aissa Mandi (Lille) for a tough tackle.
21' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
20' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
16' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
16' Thomas Meunier (Lille) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The ball goes out for a corner. Lille can continue in their attacking effort.
15' 58:42 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

12' A dangerous towering header by Benjamin Andre (Lille) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the right post. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Metz will have a goal kick.
11' Lille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

10' Mathias Fernandez-Pardo (Lille) reacted quickly inside the box and got on the end of the resulting corner. He drilled a low shot towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulled off an astonishing save to deny him.
10' Good work from Lille as they win a corner.

10' Chancel Mbemba (Lille) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. The ball is out of play. Lille will have a chance to score from a corner.
9' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) will take the corner.

8' Hamza Igamane (Lille) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the left post is blocked by Pape Sy, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
7' Lille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

3' A clever short pass gives Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
2' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Lille will have a goal kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Metz will kick-off.
Benoit Millot is introduced as the referee for today's match.
